concepts.def: Uninterrupted, affordable access to energy resources; balanced via diversity and storage.
Coal, oil, natural gas; provide ~80% global primary energy (IEA 2023); main CO2 source.
Solar, wind, hydro, geothermal, biomass; share growing; intermittency requires storage/grid.
U-235 splits with neutron release; ~10% global electricity (IEA); waste storage controversial.
Equilibrium warming for doubled CO2; IPCC AR6 best estimate 3 degrees C (range 2.5-4).
2015 COP21 treaty: limit warming well below 2 degrees C, pursue 1.5 degrees C; NDC mechanism.
